_comment: Characteristic curves from the makers' technical data, read off the vector graphics of the PDF (pdf.js operator lists, Bezier curves sampled, axes from the graph's grid lines). lgh: log10 exposure in lux-seconds; curves: diffuse density incl. base + fog, one per development time where the sheet gives a family (time = minutes in the sheet's own process), ref_time = the standard time of that process. contrast: the sheet's measure (gamma or contrast index). Each developer: its contrast-time curve (t -> c), standard time and EI, and push times (stops -> minutes) where the sheet gives them.
